C. Custom Functions

#some self-created functions that I frequently use
freq <- function(x) {
frequency <- table(x, useNA = "ifany")
proportion <- round(prop.table(table(x, useNA = "ifany"),),3)
cbind(frequency, proportion)
}

freq_sort <- function(x) {
frequency <- table(x, useNA = "ifany")
proportion <- round(prop.table(table(x, useNA = "ifany"),),3)
out <- cbind(frequency, proportion)
out[order(out[,1],decreasing=TRUE),]
}

freq2 = function(x,y){
table(x,y, useNA = "ifany")
}

freq2_col <-function(x,y){
prop.table(table(x,y,useNA = "ifany"),2)
}

freq2_row <-function(x,y){
prop.table(table(x,y,useNA = "ifany"),1)
}

  ttable <- function(dependent, by_variable){
  level <- c("By variable=0", "By variable=1", "Difference")
  means <- round(c(mean(dependent[by_variable==0], na.rm=TRUE),
  mean(dependent[by_variable==1], na.rm=TRUE),
  mean(dependent[by_variable==1], na.rm=TRUE) -
  mean(dependent[by_variable==0], na.rm=TRUE)),3)
  se_0 <- sd(dependent[by_variable==0],
  na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(dependent[by_variable==0])))
  se_1 <- sd(dependent[by_variable==1],
  na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(dependent[by_variable==1])))
  se_diff <-sqrt(se_0^2+ se_1^2)
  se <- round(c(se_0, se_1, se_diff),3)
  data_correction <- c(1,1,2)
  N <- c(sum(!is.na(dependent[by_variable==0])) ,
  sum(!is.na(dependent[by_variable==01])), sum(!is.na(dependent)))
  results <- as.data.frame(cbind(level, means, se, N, data_correction))
  results$means <-as.numeric(results$means)
  results$se <-as.numeric(results$se)
  results$N <-as.numeric(results$N)
  results$data_correction <-as.numeric(results$data_correction)
  ttable <- results %>%
  mutate(t_stat = round(means/se,3),
  data_t = N - data_correction,
  p_value = 2*pt(abs(t_stat), data=data_t, lower.tail=FALSE)
  ) %>%
  select(level, means, se, t_stat, data_t, p_value )
  rm(level, means, se_0, se_1, se_diff, se, data_correction, N, results)
  ttable
}

IV. Income Trends by Ownership Status

A. Summary Table: Average Income by Tenure and multyear (Lara. RR)

income_summary <- data %>%
  filter(multyear %in% c(2014, 2023),
         tenure_general %in% c("Owned", "Rented")) %>%
  mutate(income = as.numeric(as.character(income))) %>%
  group_by(multyear, tenure_general) %>%
  summarise(avg_income = mean(income, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

print(income_summary)

B. Line Plot: Average Income Over Time by Tenure (Lara. RR )

data$income <- as.numeric(as.character(data$income))

data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(tenure_general %in% c("Owned", "Rented")) %>%
  group_by(multyear, tenure_general) %>%
  summarise(mean_income = mean(income, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = multyear, y = mean_income, color = tenure_general)) +
  # Highlight 2018-2024 period with a shaded region (behind everything)
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2018, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = "lightyellow", alpha = 0.1) +
  # Add a grey dotted line at the multyear 2020 (behind the trend lines)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, linetype = "dotted", color = "lightgray", size = 1) +
  # Dotted line for 2020
  # Add the trend lines on top
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +  # Use linewidth instead of size for trend lines
  labs(x = "multyear", y = "Average Income", title = "Avg. Income, Owners vs. Renters (2014 - 2023)", color = " ") + # Customize the legend title
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Owned" = "blue", "Rented" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()

B. Homeownership Summary by Sex (Lara. RR. TO REVISE)

homeownership <- data %>%
  filter(sex_head %in% c("Female", "Male"),
         tenure_general %in% c("Owned", "Rented")) %>%
  group_by(multyear, sex_head) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    owned = sum(tenure_general == "Owned"),
    prop_owned = owned / total,  # proportion owned (0 to 1)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_owned_pct = prop_owned * 100)

head(homeownership)

(Lara. RR)

homeownership_summary <- homeownership %>%
  group_by(sex_head) %>%
  summarise(min_multyear = min(multyear),
            max_multyear = max(multyear),
            n_observations = n(),
            min_rate = min(prop_owned_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_rate = max(prop_owned_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_rate = mean(prop_owned_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_rate = median(prop_owned_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_rate = sd(prop_owned_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

print(homeownership_summary)

A. Summary Table for Cost Burden (Owners) (Lara. RR TO REVISE )

data %>%
  filter(sex_head %in% c("Female", "Male"),
         tenure_general %in% c("Owned", "Rented")) %>%
  mutate(group = paste(sex_head, tenure_general)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    non_missing = sum(!is.na(housing_cost_burden)),
    mean_burden = mean(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_burden = median(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

(Lara. RR TO REVISE)

summary_owned <- data %>%
  # Keep only rows for Female or Male, tenure = Owned, and valid non-NA housing cost burden
  filter(sex_head %in% c("Female", "Male"),
         tenure_general == "Owned",
         !is.na(housing_cost_burden)) %>%
  # Ensure housing_cost_burden is numeric
  mutate(housing_cost_burden = as.numeric(as.character(housing_cost_burden))) %>%
  # Create a grouping variable that labels each row as either "Female Owned" or "Male Owned"
  mutate(group = paste(sex_head, tenure_general)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    min_multyear       = min(multyear, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_multyear       = max(multyear, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_observations = n(),
    min_burden     = min(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_burden     = max(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_burden    = mean(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_burden  = median(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_burden      = sd(housing_cost_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

# Print the table to see your summary stats
print(summary_owned)

B. Plot: Average Housing Cost Burden (Owners) (Lara. RR)

# 1. numeric burden
data$housing_cost_burden <- as.numeric(as.character(data$housing_cost_burden))

# 2. keep valid rows & only Owned
data_grouped <- data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(housing_cost_burden),
         between(housing_cost_burden, 0, 1),
         sex_head %in% c("Female", "Male"),
         tenure_general == "Owned") %>%            # only owners
  mutate(group = paste(sex_head, "Owned")) %>%     # “Female Owned”, “Male Owned”
  group_by(multyear, group) %>% 
  summarise(mean_cost_burden = mean(housing_cost_burden) * 1000,
            .groups = "drop")

# 3. x-position for threshold labels
x_label <- min(data_grouped$multyear) + 
           (max(data_grouped$multyear) - min(data_grouped$multyear)) / 4

# 4. y-axis transform: linear ≤ 50, compressed above 50
compress_trans <- trans_new(
  "compress",
  transform = function(x) ifelse(x <= 50, x, 50 + (x - 50) / 10),
  inverse   = function(y) ifelse(y <= 50, y, (y - 50) * 10 + 50)
)

# 5. plot
ggplot(data_grouped,
       aes(multyear, mean_cost_burden, colour = group, linetype = group)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2018, xmax = 2024, ymin = 0, ymax = 100,
           fill = "lightyellow", alpha = .1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "lightgray", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, colour = "green")  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, colour = "orange") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, colour = "red")   +
  annotate("text", x = x_label, y = 30,
           label = "Affordable (<30%)", colour = "green",  vjust = -0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_label, y = 50,
           label = "Moderate (30-50%)", colour = "orange", vjust = -0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_label, y = 100,
           label = "Severe (>50%)",     colour = "red",    vjust = -0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = compress_trans,
                     name  = "Average Housing Cost Burden (%)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Female Owned" = "purple",
                                 "Male Owned"   = "orange")) +   # typo fixed
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Female Owned" = "solid",
                                   "Male Owned"   = "solid")) +  # typo fixed
  labs(title   = "Homeowner Housing Cost Burden Trends by Sex (2014-2024)",
       x       = "multyear",
       colour  = "Group",
       linetype = "Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

VIII. Housing Burden

 households <- data %>%
  mutate(
    income = as.numeric(income),
    weight_household = as.numeric(weight_household),
    puma = as.integer(puma),
    multyear = as.integer(multyear)
  )

A. AMI (KP)

ami_by_puma_multyear <- households %>%
  group_by(puma, multyear) %>%
  summarise(AMI = weightedMedian(income, w = weight_household, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ami_by_puma_multyear

0. Define AMI Category

households <- households %>%
  left_join(ami_by_puma_multyear, by = c("puma", "multyear")) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_ami = income / AMI,
    ami_category = case_when(
      percent_ami < 0.15 ~ "0–15% AMI",
      percent_ami >= 0.15 & percent_ami < 0.30 ~ "15–30% AMI",
      percent_ami >= 0.30 & percent_ami < 0.50 ~ "30–50% AMI",
      percent_ami >= 0.50 & percent_ami < 0.80 ~ "50–80% AMI",
      percent_ami >= 0.80 & percent_ami < 1.20 ~ "80–120% AMI",
      percent_ami >= 1.20 ~ "120%+ AMI",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    mi_category = factor(
      ami_category,
      levels = c("0–15% AMI", "15–30% AMI", "30–50% AMI", "50–80% AMI", "80–120% AMI", "120%+ AMI")
    )
  )

1. Trend Over Time by AMI Category

Shows how cost burden changed over time within each AMI group.

households %>%
  filter(multyear >= 2018, !is.na(ami_category), !is.na(housing_cost_burden)) %>%
  mutate(burden_flag = housing_cost_burden > 0.3) %>%
  group_by(multyear, ami_category) %>%
  summarise(overburdened = weighted.mean(burden_flag, weight_household, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = multyear, y = overburdened, color = ami_category)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Cost Burden Over Time by AMI Category (2018–2023)",
    x = "Year", y = "Percent Overburdened", color = "AMI Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

  filter(!is.na(ami_category), !is.na(housing_cost_burden)) %>%

  geom_boxplot(fill = "#3b7ea1", alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +

  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Housing Cost Burden by AMI Category",

  ) +

  theme(legend.position = "top")

households %>%
  group_by(disability_head, tenure_detailed) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(weight_household, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(disability_head) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tenure_detailed, y = share, fill = disability_head)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Ownership by Disability Status", x = "Tenure", y = "Share") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

D. By Age Group

households %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_head_group)) %>%
  group_by(age_head_group, tenure_detailed) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(weight_household, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(age_head_group) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tenure_detailed, y = share, fill = age_head_group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Ownership by Age Group of Household Head",
    x = "Tenure Type", y = "Share",
    fill = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
